items.title: August Laurent Interview, 1960-03-21
items.q: He gave me that amazure. That's why I got my amazure from T.O.

ctx.x: Before I forget, I don't like to interrupt you, but I want to ask about T.O. How did he hold his lips?
The same way. He gave me that amazure. That's why I got my amazure from T.O.
